description: Create a link that puts files onto an item from outside TaskLite: the customer's photos, a signed contract, a logo, a build zip. Returns an address like https://app.tasklite.net/upload/<token> that anyone you hand it to can use with no account, no login and no API key; pass clientEmail and TaskLite emails the link for you. What arrives lands as attachments on that item, and list_uploaded_files reads them back with a download URL. This is the answer when the person has the file and the model does not: a hosted client cannot read a folder on someone's machine. The link is public for as long as it lasts, so keep expiryDays short and maxFiles tight, and revoke_upload_link when the material is in.

clientEmail.description: Send the link to this address. Omit to get the link back and pass it on yourself

clientName.description: Who is being asked, shown on the upload page

expiryDays.description: How long the link lives. Default 7 days

itemId.description: Item (row) the files belong to, from query_items / create_item. Make the row first if the material has no home yet

maxFiles.description: How many files the link accepts before it stops. Default 10

message.description: What to upload, in the words the recipient will read: "the four room photos and the price list"

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: request_file_upload
